concept: Decadent artisan chocolatier: a deep berry-bordeaux primary like a dark ganache, warmed by a caramel-gold accent that pops on dark hero imagery. Espresso ink on creamy warm backgrounds evokes luxe, indulgent, hand-crafted confections.
contrastNotes: All WCAG-AA checks pass. ink #2A1810 on bg #FBF6EF = 15.79:1 (>=7). ink-soft #6B4A36 on bg = 7.35:1 (>=4.5). white on primary #7A2E40 = 9.16:1 (>=4.5). primary on bg = 8.52:1 (>=3). accent #E0A43B on near-black #000 = 9.54:1 (>=3), so the caramel-gold reads as a bright pop on dark hero sections.
